<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: right"><B>Exhibit 3(ii)</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.25in 0 4pt; text-align: justify"><B><U>EXHIBIT 3(ii): BYLAWS</U></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0.7pt 12pt 0; text-align: center">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>CORPORATE BYLAWS</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt"><B>of</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>MINERALRITE CORPORATION</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>(as amended 09-18-2024)</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>&#8201;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&#8201;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>ARTICLE <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">1</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>Company <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Formation</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&#8201;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">1.01</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>FORMATION.</B> This Corporation is formed pursuant to the Business Organizations Code (the Code&#8221;), the Texas For-Profit Corporation Law (the &#8220;Law&#8221;), and the laws of the State of Texas.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">1.02</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>CORPORATE ARTICLES COMPLIANCE.</B> The Board of Directors (the &#8220;Board&#8221;) acknowledges and agrees that they caused the Corporation&#8217;s Articles of Incorporation (the &#8220;Articles&#8221;) to be filed with the Texas Secretary of State and all filing fees have been paid and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">satisfied.</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">1.03</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>REGISTERED OFFICE &amp; REGISTERED AGENT.</B> Per Section 5.201 of the Code, the Board agrees that the Corporation&#8217;s registered agent for service of process is located in the State of Texas, as stated in the Articles. The Corporation may change its registered agent by resolution of the Board and filing a statement with the Secretary of State setting forth the change. Pursuant to the Section 3.151 of the Code, the Board is obligated to maintain and update the corporate records on file with the Corporation&#8217;s registered agent.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">1.04</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>OTHER OFFICES.</B> The Corporation may have other offices as selected by the Board per Section 2.101 of the Law.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">1.05</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>CORPORATE SEAL.</B> Pursuant to Section 2.101 of the Code, the Board may decline to adopt a corporate seal with the form and inscription of their choosing.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">1.06</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>PURPOSE.</B> Pursuant to Section 2.001 of the Code, this Corporation is formed to engage in any lawful business purpose.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">1.07</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>ADOPTION OF BYLAWS.</B> Pursuant to Section 21.057 of the Law, the Board has caused the adoption of these corporate bylaws (&#8220;Bylaws&#8221;) on behalf of the Corporation.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>&#8201;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>&#8201;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>ARTICLE <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">2</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>Board of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Directors</FONT></B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>&#8201;</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.01</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>INITIAL MEETING OF THE BOARD.</B> Per Section 21.059 of the Law, the Board has conducted and completed the initial organizational meeting of the Corporation.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.02</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>POWERS AND NUMBERS.</B> Pursuant to Section 21.401 of the Law, the management of all the Corporation&#8217;s affairs, property, and interests shall be managed by or under the direction of the Board. Per Section 21.403 of the Law, the Board of the Corporation shall be comprised of the number of directors listed in the Articles, unless expressly altered by these Bylaws. Consistent with Section 21.402 of the Law, the Board consists of at least one (1) natural person who need not be a shareholder or resident of the State of Texas.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&#8201;</P>

</DIV>
</CENTER>

<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">

<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.03</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>DIRECTOR LIABILITY.</B> Each director is required, individually and collectively, to act in good faith, with reasonable and prudent care, and in the best interest of the Corporation. If a director acts consistent with Section 21.316 of the Law and in the best interest of the Corporation, then they shall be immune from liability arising from official acts on behalf of the Corporation. Directors are presumed to act in compliance with the best interest of the Corporation and Section 21.316 of the Law.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.65pt 0 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#8201;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0.025in"></TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0.5in">&nbsp;<FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Directors who fail to comply with the best interest of the Corporation
  and Sections 21.303 <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">and 21.316 </FONT>of the Law shall be personally liable to the Corporation
  for any improper distributions and as otherwise described in Section 21.316 of the Law and these Bylaws.</FONT></TD></TR>
</TABLE>


<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.04</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>CLASSES OF DIRECTORS.</B> Until such time as the Articles are accordingly amended, the Corporation does not have classes of directors.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.05</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>CHANGE OF NUMBER.</B> The number of directors may be changed at any time by amendment of these Bylaws, pursuant to the process outlined in Article 10 of these Bylaws. A decrease in number does not have the effect of shortening the term of any incumbent director. In the event the established number of directors is decreased, the directors shall hold their positions until the next shareholder meeting occurs and new directors are elected and qualified.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.06</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>ELECTION &amp; REMOVAL OF DIRECTORS.</B> Per Sections 21.405 and 21.407 of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Law, directors </FONT>are to be voted on and elected at each annual shareholder meeting for a term of <U>one (1) year</U>. A director shall hold office until their successor is duly elected and qualified at the following annual shareholder meeting, unless a special meeting is expressly called to remove a director and/or fill a vacancy. If a director is elected, but is not yet qualified to hold office, then the previous director shall holdover until such time that the newly elected director is so qualified. Pursuant to Section 21.409 of the Law, one or more directors of the Board may be removed by an affirmative vote by the holders of a majority of stock entitled to vote at any meeting of shareholders called expressly for that purpose.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.07</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>VACANCIES.</B> Per Section 21.410 of the Law, all vacancies in the Board may be filled by the affirmative vote of a majority of the remaining directors, <I>provided </I>that any such director who fills a vacancy is qualified to be a director and shall only hold the office until a new director is elected by the shareholders at the next meeting of the shareholders. Any director who fills a vacancy on the Board shall not be considered unqualified or disqualified solely by virtue of being an interim director. Pursuant to Section 21.410 of the Law, any director elected by the shareholders to fill a vacancy which results from the removal of a director shall serve the remainder of the annual term of the removed director and until a successor is elected by the shareholders and qualified. The Board may fill a vacancy created by an increase in the number of directors for a term lasting until the next annual election of directors by the shareholders at the annual meeting or a special meeting called for the purpose of electing directors.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.08</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>REGULAR MEETINGS.</B> Pursuant to Sections 6.001 and 6.002 of the Code, the meetings of the Board or any committee may be held at the Corporation&#8217;s principal office or at any other place designated by the Board or its committee, including by means of remote communication which allows all persons participating in the meeting to hear each other at the same time. The annual meeting of the Board will be held without notice immediately after the adjournment of the annual meeting of shareholders.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.09</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>SPECIAL MEETINGS.</B> Pursuant to Sections 6.001 and 6.002 of the Code, special meetings of the Board may be held at any place and at any time, including by means of remote communication which allows all persons participating in the meeting to hear each other at the same time, and may be called by the Chairman of the Board, the President, Vice President, Secretary, or Treasurer, or at least two (2) directors. Any special meeting of the Board must be preceded by at least forty-eight (48) hours' notice of the date, time, place, and purpose of the meeting, unless these Bylaws require otherwise.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>


<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.10</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>ACTION BY DIRECTORS WITHOUT A MEETING.</B> Pursuant to Section 6.201 of the Code and Section 21.415 of the Act, any action which may be taken at a meeting of the Board, or its committee, may be taken without a meeting, <I>provided </I>all directors or committee members unanimously agree and sign a</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>
</DIV>
</CENTER>

<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 0.5in"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">consent that sets forth the action taken by the Board.
The signed consent is to be filed with the minutes of the proceeding.</TD></TR>
</TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.52in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.11</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>NOTICE OF MEETINGS.</B> Pursuant to Section 21.411 of the Law, the regular meetings of the Board shall be held without notice of the date, time, place, or purpose of the meeting, provided the meeting of the Board follows the adjournment of the annual shareholder meeting. Notice may be given personally, by facsimile, by mail, or in any other lawful manner, so long as the method for notice comports with Article 8 of these Bylaws. Oral notification is sufficient only if a written record of the notice is included in the Corporation's minute book. Notice is effective at the earliest of:</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">&thinsp;</TD></TR>
</TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 0; width: 0.52in">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 0; width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(a)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Receipt;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Delivery to the proper address or telephone number of the director(s) as shown in the Corporation's records; or</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Five (5) days after its deposit in the United States mail, as evidenced by the postmark, if correctly addressed and mailed with first-class postage prepaid.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.12</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>WAIVER OF NOTICE.</B> Pursuant to Section 21.412 of the Law, a director waives the notice requirement if that director attends or participates in the meeting, unless a director attends for the express purpose of promptly objecting to the transaction of any business because the meeting was not lawfully called or convened. Under Section 21.412 of the Law, a director may waive notice by a signed writing, delivered to the Corporation for inclusion in the minutes before or after the meeting.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.13</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>QUORUM.</B> Per Section 21.413 of the Law, a majority of the entire Board constitutes a quorum, and a quorum is necessary at any meeting where an action to transact business occurs.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.14</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>REGISTERING DISSENT.</B> Pursuant to Section 21.414 of the Law, a director who is present at a meeting where an action to transact business occurs is presumed to have assented to such action, unless the director expressly dissents to the action. A valid dissent must be entered in the meeting&#8217;s minutes, filed with the meeting&#8217;s acting Secretary before its adjournment, or forwarded by registered mail to the Corporation&#8217;s Secretary within twenty-four (24) hours after the meeting&#8217;s adjournment. These options for dissent do not apply to a director who voted in favor of the action or failed to express such dissent at the meeting.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.15</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>EXECUTIVE AND OTHER COMMITTEES.</B> Subject to Section 21.416 of the Law, the Board may create committees to delegate certain powers to act on behalf of the Board, provided the Board passes a resolution indicating such creation or delegation. Notwithstanding the power to create committees, no committee may issue stock, recommend shareholder actions, nor amend these Bylaws. The Board may delegate to a committee the power to appoint directors to fill vacancies on the Board. All committees must record regular minutes of their meetings and keep the minute book at the corporation&#8217;s office. The creation or appointment of a committee does not relieve the Board or its members from their standard of care described in Section 2.03 of these Bylaws or in Section 7.001 of the Code and Section 21.316 of the Law.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 6pt; width: 0.5in">2.16</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 6pt; text-align: justify"><B>COMPENSATION.</B> The Board may adopt a resolution which results in directors being paid a reasonable compensation for their services rendered as directors of the Corporation. Directors may also be paid a fixed sum and expenses, if any, for attendance at each regular or special meeting of such Board. Nothing contained in these Bylaws precludes a director from receiving compensation for serving the Corporation in any other capacity, including any services rendered as an officer or employee. If the Board accordingly passes a resolution, then committee members may be allowed like compensation for attending committee meetings.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" BORDER="0" STYLE="width: 100%; margin-top: 0.1in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0.025in"></TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0.5in">&nbsp;</TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">A resolution of the Board that grants compensation to a director may be challenged by a shareholder, provided the shareholder requests
a special shareholder meeting specifically addressing the resolution related to director compensation. Any Board resolution that relates
to director compensation can be overturned by a majority vote of shareholders.</TD></TR>
</TABLE>

</DIV>
</CENTER>


<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">2.17</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>INDEMNIFICATION.</B> Provided the director complies with the standard of care described in Section 2.03 of these Bylaws and Section 7.001 of the Code and Sections 21.303 and 21.316 of the Law, the Corporation shall indemnify any director made a party to a proceeding, brought or threatened, as a consequence of the director acting in their official capacity. In the event a director is entitled to indemnification by the Corporation, the director shall be indemnified pursuant to the process outlined in Sections 8.051 and 8.101 of the Code.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.05pt 5.5pt 0 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>ARTICLE <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">3</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt"><B>Stock</B></FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>&#8201;</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">3.01</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>AUTHORITY TO ISSUE.</B> Subject to Sections 21.151, 21.154, 21.157, and 21.159 of the Law and the Corporation&#8217;s Articles, the Corporation is authorized to issue any class of stock or securities convertible into stock of any class. Before any stock of the Corporation may be issued, the Board must pass a resolution which authorizes the issuance, sets the minimum consideration for the stock or security (or a formula to determine the minimum consideration), and fairly describes any non-monetary consideration.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">3.02</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>RESTRICTIONS.</B> Stock may only be issued pursuant to the Articles, and by the process described in these Bylaws. Any issuance of stock exceeding the amount described in the Articles requires Board authorization, approval from the majority of shareholders, and an amendment to the Articles. Per Section 21.213 of the Law, any restriction on the transferability of stock shall be fully furnished to the shareholders, upon request, and without any charge to the shareholder. Per Section 21.213 of the Law, any failure to furnish such information to the shareholder or a transferee without actual knowledge of the restriction renders the restriction on stock transferability invalid or unenforceable.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" BORDER="0" STYLE="width: 100%; margin-top: 0.1in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0.025in">&nbsp;</TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0.5in">&nbsp;</TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">As provided in Section 21.203 of the Law, no shareholder has a preemptive right to subscribe to any subsequent or additional issuance
of stock.</TD></TR>
</TABLE>


<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&thinsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">3.03</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>STOCK CERTIFICATES.</B> Under Section 3.202 of the Code, shareholders are entitled to stock certificates that certify the shares of the Corporation&#8217;s stock held by the shareholder. Notwithstanding the shareholders&#8217; rights to stock certificates, the Board may authorize the issuance of some or all shares of any class or series of stock without certificates, provided the Board shall provide to a shareholder a written statement that contains the information required to be on stock certificates, per Section 3.205 of the Code.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" BORDER="0" STYLE="width: 100%; margin-top: 0.1in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0.025in">&nbsp;</TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0.5in">&nbsp;</TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Per Sections 3.202 and 3.203 of the Code, each stock certificate must contain on its <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">face:</FONT></TD></TR>
</TABLE>


<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt; padding-top: 0; width: 0.025in">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt; padding-top: 0; width: 0.5in">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 0; width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(a)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 0; text-align: justify">The Corporation name and that the Corporation is organized under the laws of this <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">State;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">The name of the shareholder (or person to whom the stock is <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">issued);</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-bottom: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">The number and class of shares and the designation of the series, if any, the certificate represents; and</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD>&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD>&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(d)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">The signature of two officers designated in these Bylaws or by the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Board.</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">&#8201;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" BORDER="0" STYLE="width: 100%; margin-top: 0; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0.025in"></TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify; width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
  <TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">For </FONT>the sake of clarity, in the event that an individual serves multiple roles within the
Corporation, that person <I>cannot</I> countersign any document which that person has already signed in their official or individual
capacity. If an officer who has signed or whose facsimile signature appears on any stock certificate ceases to be an officer before the
certificate is issued to the shareholder, it may be issued by the Corporation and is valid as if the person were an officer on the date
of issuance. The certificate may be sealed with the Corporation&#8217;s seal.</TD></TR>
</TABLE>


<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="font: italic 9pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; color: Gray; width: 80%">Please review pages 2 &amp; 3 - Cautionary Notes on Forward-Looking Statements.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 20%; text-align: right"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->4<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&thinsp;</P></DIV>

<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">3.04</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>MUTILATED, LOST, OR DESTROYED CERTIFICATES.</B> Per Section 21.057 of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Law, in the </FONT>instance of any mutilation, loss, or destruction of any stock certificate, another may be issued in its place on proof of such mutilation, loss or destruction. The Board may impose conditions on such issuance and may require the giving of a satisfactory bond or indemnity to the Corporation. The Board may establish other procedures as they deem necessary.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.52in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">3.05</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>FRACTIONAL SHARES OR SCRIP.</B> Subject to Section 21.163 of the Law, the Corporation <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">may:</FONT></TD></TR>
</TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.5in">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(a)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Issue fractions of a share which entitle the holder to exercise voting rights, to receive dividends, and to participate in any of the Corporation&#8217;s assets in the event of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">liquidation;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Arrange for the disposition of fractional interests by those entitled <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">thereto;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Pay the fair market value, in cash, of fractions of a share as of the time when those entitled to receive such shares are determined; or</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(d)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Issue scrip in a form which entitles the holder to receive a certificate for the full share upon surrender of such scrip aggregating a full share.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">3.06</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>TRANSFER.</B> So long as there is no transferability restriction on the stock, as described in Section 3.02 of these Bylaws, the stock of the Corporation is freely transferable. Transfers of stock must be made upon the corporation&#8217;s stock transfer books. Stock transfer books shall be kept in the manner described in Article 7 of these Bylaws.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.1in 0 0 0.52in; text-align: justify">Before a new certificate is issued,
the old certificate must be surrendered for cancellation. The Board may, by resolution, open a share register in any state of the United
States, and may employ an agent or agents to keep such register, and to record transfers or shares therein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.1in 0 0 0.5in; text-align: justify">&thinsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">3.07</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>REGISTERED OWNER.</B> The Corporation shall recognize an individual as the registered owner of a given stock, <I>provided </I>that individual is determined as the shareholder of record by the record date as set out in Section 4.07 of these Bylaws. Shareholders may agree to confer the right to vote or represent their stock to third parties, including trustees, proxies, or fiduciaries. The Board may resolve to adopt a procedure by which a shareholder of the Corporation may certify in writing to the Corporation that all or a portion of the stock registered in the shareholder&#8217;s name are held for the account of a specified person or persons. The resolution must set forth:</TD></TR>
</TABLE>


<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.52in">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(a)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">The classification of shareholder who may <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">certify;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">The purpose or purposes for which the certification may be <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">made;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">The form of certification and information to be contained <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">therein;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(d)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">If the certification is with respect to a record date or closing of the stock transfer books, the date within which the certification must be received by the Corporation; and</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(e)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Other provisions with respect to the procedure as are deemed necessary or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">desirable.</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 3pt 0 0 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">&#8201;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 3pt 0 0 0.52in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Upon
</FONT>receipt of a certification complying with this procedure, the Corporation must treat the persons specified in the certification
as the holders of record for the number of shares specified in place of the shareholder making the certification.</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">3.08</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>CLASSES OR SERIES OF STOCK.</B> Until such time that the Articles are amended accordingly, the stock of the Corporation is not classified, and is not in series. In the event the Board decides to classify or reclassify the stock or alter any shareholder rights or restrictions, then the Board shall cause an amendment to its Articles to be filed with the Secretary of State. The amendment must describe the rights and restrictions which are being modified or altered, along with a statement (if any) that the stock has been classified or reclassified. Pursuant to Sections 21.053 through 21.055 of the Law, the amendment shall be acknowledged and signed by either a director or an executive officer on behalf of the Board, or an agent authorized to submit filings on the Corporation&#8217;s behalf.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
</DIV>
</CENTER>
