<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">3.09</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 6pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>STOCK OWNED BY ENTITIES.</B> Per Section 21.366 of the Law, stock held by another corporation may be voted by that other corporation&#8217;s officer, agent, or proxy chosen by its board of directors, or, in the absence of such determination, by the president of that other corporation. Per Section 21.366 of the Law, shares of stock in the Corporation held by a fiduciary of the named shareholder may be voted or represented by the fiduciary.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.1in 0 0 0.52in; text-align: justify">Subject to Section 21.366 of the Law,
the Corporation may vote or represent stock that it holds in itself, <I>provided </I>the Corporation holds such stock in a fiduciary capacity.
If the Corporation holds stock in itself in such a fiduciary capacity, then such stock shall be counted in determining the total number
of outstanding shares of stock at a given time.</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.4pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>ARTICLE <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">4</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>Shareholders' Meetings</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>&#8201;</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.01</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>MEETING PLACE.</B> Per Section 21.351 of the Law, all shareholder meetings must be held at the Corporation&#8217;s principal office or other place predetermined by the Board. As permitted by Section 21.3521 of the Law, shareholders may participate in the meeting by means virtual or remote conference, <I>provided </I>the participants can hear each other in real time.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0px">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 48px; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.02</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>ANNUAL MEETING TIME.</B> The annual shareholder meeting for the election of directors and</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.52in; text-align: justify">the transaction of such other business
properly before the meeting, must be held each year as shall be regularly determined by the Board. In the event that such date is a legal
holiday, then the meeting must be held on the day following, at the same hour. Pursuant to <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Section
</FONT>21.351 of the Law, failure to hold an annual meeting at the time stated in or fixed within these Bylaws does not affect the validity
of any corporate action.</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD></TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.52in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.03</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>ANNUAL MEETING &#8211; ORDER OF BUSINESS.</B> Pursuant to Section 21.351 of the Law, the order of business at the annual shareholder meeting is as follows:</TD></TR>
</TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.52in">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(a)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Calling the meeting to order;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Proof of notice of meeting (or filing of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">waiver);</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Reading of minutes of last annual meeting;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(d)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Officer reports;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(e)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Committee reports;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(f)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Election of directors;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(g)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Disclosures to shareholders; <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">and</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(h)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Miscellaneous business.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 3.7pt 5.95pt 0 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">&#8201;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.04</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>SPECIAL MEETINGS.</B> Subject to Section 21.352 of the Law, special shareholder meetings, for any purpose, may be called at any time by the President, the Board, or the Secretary. A special shareholder meeting may also be held upon request if said request is signed, dated, and delivered to the Secretary by the holders of at least one-tenth of all shares entitled to vote at the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">meeting.</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 0.5in">4.05</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>NOTICE.</B> Pursuant to Section 21.353 of the Law, the Secretary shall cause notice to be given to each shareholder of record at least ten (10) days, but no more than sixty (60) days, before the shareholders&#8217; meeting. Notice shall be by electronic transmission, mailing, or personal delivery, and shall state the time, place, and purpose of the meeting (including instructions for how to virtually attend and participate). Notice is considered given to a shareholder when it is personally provided to the shareholder, left at the shareholder&#8217;s residence or usual place of business, mailed to the shareholder&#8217;s address of record, or by electronic transmission to the shareholder&#8217;s address or number of record on file with the Corporation. A</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</DIV>
</CENTER>


<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 6; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="font: italic 9pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; color: Gray; width: 80%">Please review pages 2 &amp; 3 - Cautionary Notes on Forward-Looking Statements.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 20%; text-align: right"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->6<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&thinsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->
</DIV>
</CENTER>


<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">single notice can be delivered to multiple shareholders
sharing the same address, unless the Corporation receives a request from a shareholder that more than a single notice be delivered.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 5.95pt 0 0.5in; text-align: justify"><B>&#8201;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.52in; text-align: justify">Notice by electronic transmission shall
be considered ineffective if the Corporation is unable to deliver two (2) consecutive notices and the individual responsible for sending
notices to shareholders is made aware of the delivery failures. A shareholder meeting, and any actions taken by shareholders, shall not
be invalidated due to an inadvertent failure to deliver notice.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.52in; text-align: justify">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.52in; text-align: justify">Per Section 21.353 of the Law and Section
4.07 of these Bylaws, the notice must include the record date for determining the shareholders entitled to vote at the meeting, if such
date is different than the record date for determining shareholders entitled to notice of the meeting.</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.06</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>WAIVER OF NOTICE.</B> As stated in Section 6.052 of the Code, a shareholder who is entitled to notice may waive the notice requirement if they provide a signed written waiver of the required notice, before or after the stated meeting time, or the shareholder is present at the meeting in person or by proxy and fails to object to the holding of the meeting or particular matter at the meeting outside the purpose described in the notice.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.05pt 0 0 0.5in; text-align: justify; text-indent: -0.5in">&thinsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.07</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>RECORD DATE.</B> Consistent with Sections 21.357 and 21.372 of the Law, at least ten (10) days before each shareholder meeting, a complete record of the shareholders entitled to vote at the meeting must be made and maintained in the books and records of the Corporation. This list must be arranged in alphabetical order and include the address of and number of shares of stock held by each shareholder. This record must be kept on file at the Corporation&#8217;s principal office for a period of ten (10) days prior to the meeting. The records must also be kept open for inspection at shareholder meetings.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.08</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>CLOSING OF TRANSFER BOOKS AND FIXING RECORD DATE.</B> Subject to <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Section 21.355 of </FONT>the Law, the Board may order the stock transfer books to be closed in order to determine which shareholders are entitled to notice of or to vote at any shareholder meeting, or any adjournment thereof, or entitled to receive payment of any dividend. Instead of closing the stock transfer books, the Board may fix in advance a record date for determination of such shareholders. The record date must not be more than sixty (60) days or less than ten (10) days prior to the date of the meeting, adjournment, or payment.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&thinsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.09</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>SHAREHOLDER LIABILITY.</B> Consistent with Section 21.223 of the Law, shareholders are not liable to the Corporation or its creditors, except that in the event the agreed upon price or consideration for the stock has not been fully paid. In the event that a subscription price or consideration for stock has not been fully paid, the following people are not personally liable for the unpaid balance:</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.52in">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(a)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 5pt; text-align: justify">a transferee or assignee who acquires the stock or subscription in good faith and without knowledge or notice of the nonpayment;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 5pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 5pt; text-align: justify">a person who holds the stock as a fiduciary, although the estate in the hands of the fiduciary is liable for the nonpayment; and</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 5pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; padding-top: 5pt; text-align: justify">a pledgee or other person who holds stock as <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">security.</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.10</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>VOTING RIGHTS.</B> Pursuant to Section 21.366 of the Law and the Articles of Incorporation of the Corporation, each outstanding share of stock is entitled to vote on all such matters as may be put to a vote of the specific class or series of shares entitled to vote on the subject at a shareholder meeting; provided the voted or represented shares are held in compliance with any payment plan, subscription, or stock purchase agreement.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.11</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>PROXIES.</B> As permitted by Section 21.367 of the Law, a shareholder may vote either in person or by proxy, signed in writing by the shareholder or the shareholder&#8217;s duly authorized attorney-in-fact. No proxy is valid after eleven (11) months from the date signed, unless the proxy states otherwise. A proxy is revocable by a shareholder at any time, unless the proxy states that it is irrevocable and is coupled with an interest.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
</DIV>
</CENTER>


<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">
<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 7; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="font: italic 9pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; color: Gray; width: 80%">Please review pages 2 &amp; 3 - Cautionary Notes on Forward-Looking Statements.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 20%; text-align: right"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->7<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&thinsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->
</DIV>
</CENTER>


<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.12</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>QUORUM.</B> As provided in Section 21.358 of the Law, the presence, in person or by proxy, of shareholders entitled to cast a majority of all the outstanding voting stock constitutes a quorum. If a quorum is present at a shareholder meeting, then a majority of all the votes cast at the meeting is sufficient to approve any matter properly brought before the meeting.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">4.13</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>ACTION BY SHAREHOLDERS WITHOUT A MEETING.</B> Per Section 6.201 of the Code, any action which may be taken at any annual or special shareholder meeting may be taken without a meeting if all of the shareholders entitled to vote on the subject consent to the action in writing. Such consent has the same force and effect as a unanimous vote of the shareholders.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in; text-align: justify"><B>&#8201;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.52in; text-align: justify">Per Section 6.202 of the Code, any action
which may be taken at any annual or special shareholder meeting may be taken without a meeting and without notice if the holders of a
majority of the shares entitled to vote on the subject consent to the action in writing. Since consent of the majority is determinative,
the Corporation shall take action in accordance with the determinative consent, shall refrain from expending the Corporation&#8217;s resources
to obtain the non-determinative opinions of other holders, and shall make information available concerning the action so taken through
notification on the Corporation&#8217;s website and/or by other means. Such consent has the same force and effect as a majority vote of
the shareholders.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>ARTICLE <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">5</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt"><B>Officers</B></FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>&#8201;</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.01</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>DESIGNATIONS.</B> Consistent with Section 3.103 of the Code and Section 21.417 of the Law, the Corporation shall have a President, a Secretary, and a Treasurer, who will be elected by the directors at their first meeting after the annual shareholder meeting. The Corporation may also have one or more Vice-Presidents (one shall serve as Executive Vice-President) and Assistant Secretaries and Assistant Treasurers as the Board may designate. An elected officer will hold office for one year or until a successor is elected and qualified. For the sake of clarity and the avoidance of doubt, the same person may hold any two or more offices concurrently. All officers may be removed at any time, with or without cause, pursuant to Section 3.104 of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Code.</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 3.7pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 5.5pt"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.02</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>THE PRESIDENT.</B> Pursuant to Section 3.103 of the Code and Section 21.417 of the Law, the President shall preside over all meetings of shareholders and directors, shall have general supervision of the Corporation&#8217;s affairs, and perform all other duties as are incident to the office or are properly required by a resolution passed by the Board.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.03</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>VICE PRESIDENT.</B> Per Section 3.103 of the Code, during the absence or disability of the President, the Executive Vice-President may exercise all functions of the President. Each Vice- President shall have such powers and fulfill such duties as may be assigned by a resolution of the Board.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.04</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>SECRETARY AND ASSISTANT SECRETARIES.</B> Pursuant to Section 3.103 of the Code and 21.417 of the Law, the Secretary must:</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.52in">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(a)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Issue notices for all meetings and actions of the Board or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">shareholders;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Accept all requests for special meetings of the Board or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">shareholders;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Accept all notices of proxy appointments and revocations;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(d)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Keep the minutes of all meetings;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(e)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Accept delivery of any dissent announced at any meeting of the Board or <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">shareholders;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(f)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Acknowledge and execute any stock certificates;</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(g)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Have charge of the corporate seal and books; <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">and</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&thinsp;</P>

</DIV>
</CENTER>


<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">
<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 8; Value: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2pt solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="font: italic 9pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; color: Gray; width: 80%">Please review pages 2 &amp; 3 - Cautionary Notes on Forward-Looking Statements.</TD><TD STYLE="width: 20%; text-align: right"><!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->8<!-- Field: /Sequence --></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&thinsp;</P></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->
</DIV>
</CENTER>


<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.52in">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(h)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Make reports and perform duties as are incident to the office, or are properly required of him or her by the Board.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 3pt 6.2pt 0 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 3pt 0 0 0.52in; text-align: justify">The Assistant Secretary, or Assistant
Secretaries (in the order designated by the Board), will perform all of the duties of the Secretary during the absence or disability of
the Secretary, and at other times may perform such duties as are directed by the President or the Board.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&thinsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.05</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>THE TREASURER.</B> Pursuant to Section 3.103 of the Code, the Treasurer <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">shall:</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.52in">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(a)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Have custody of all the Corporation&#8217;s monies and securities and keep regular books of <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">account;</FONT></TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(b)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Disburse the Corporation&#8217;s funds in payment of the just demands against the Corporation or as may be ordered by the Board, taking proper vouchers for such disbursements; and</TD></TR>
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.05pt">(c)</FONT></TD>
    <TD STYLE="padding-top: 5pt; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify">Provide the Board with an account of all his or her transactions as Treasurer and of the financial conditions of the office properly required of him or her by the Board.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 10pt 0 0 0.52in; text-align: justify">If selected, the Assistant Treasurer,
or Assistant Treasurers (in the order designated by the Board), must perform the duties of the Treasurer in the absence or disability
of the Treasurer, and at other times may perform such other duties as are directed by the President or the Board.</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.06</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>DELEGATION.</B> In the absence or inability to act of any officer and of any person authorized to act in their place, the Board may delegate the officer&#8217;s powers or duties to any other officer, director, or other person, subject to Section 5.01 of these Bylaws. Vacancies in any office arising from any cause may be filled by the Board, subject to Section 5.01 of these Bylaws, at any regular or special board meeting.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 5.7pt"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.07</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>OTHER OFFICERS.</B> Per Section 3.103 of the Code, the Board may appoint other officers and agents as they deem necessary or expedient. The term, powers, and duties of such officers will be determined by the Board and described in the resolution authorizing the appointment.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.08</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>LOANS.</B> Notwithstanding any duty to indemnify, no loans may be made by the Corporation to any officer, unless first approved by a two-thirds majority vote of all the outstanding the voting shares entitled to vote on the matter.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.09</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>BONDS.</B> The Board may resolve to require any officer to give bonds to the Corporation, with sufficient surety or sureties, conditioned upon the faithful performance of the duties of their offices and compliance with other conditions as required by the Board.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.10</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>SALARIES.</B> Officers&#8217; salaries and compensation packages will be fixed from time to time by the Board. Officers are not prevented from receiving a salary by reason of the fact that they are also a director of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Corporation.</FONT></TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">5.11</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>INDEMNIFICATION.</B> Subject to Section 8.105 of the Code, officers shall be indemnified by the Corporation, so long as the officer acted in a manner substantially similar to and consistent with the standard of care described in Section 3.105 of the Code. Any officer indemnification shall be limited to proceedings that are directly related to or have arisen out of the officer&#8217;s acts on behalf of the Corporation.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.35pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>&#8201;</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: center"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in; text-align: center; text-indent: -0.5in"><B>ARTICLE <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">6</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in; text-align: center; text-indent: -0.5in"><B>Capital &amp; <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Finance</FONT></B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>&#8201;</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 0.5in">6.01</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>DIVIDENDS.</B> Subject to Sections 21.302 and 21.303 of the Law, dividends may be declared by the Board and paid by the Corporation out of the net earnings of the unreserved and unrestricted earned surplus of the Corporation, or out of the unreserved and unrestricted net earnings of the current fiscal year, or in treasury shares of the Corporation, subject to the conditions and limitations imposed by the State of Texas. The stock transfer books may be closed by the Board and Sections 3.07 and 4.07 of these Bylaws. The Board, without </TD></TR>
</TABLE>

    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>RESERVES.</B> Pursuant to Section 21.309 of the Law, the Board may, in their absolute discretion, set aside out of the Corporation&#8217;s earned net surplus as they deem expedient for dividend, while maintaining any corporate property, or any other purpose, before making any distribution of earned surplus.</TD></TR>

    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>DEPOSITORIES.</B> The Corporation&#8217;s monies must be deposited in the Corporation&#8217;s name in a bank or trust company or trust companies designated by resolution of the Board. Corporate monies may be drawn out only by check or other order for payment signed by such persons and in such manner as may be determined by resolution of the Board.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 6.05pt 0 0.5in; text-align: justify">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>ARTICLE <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">7</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>Books and <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt">Records</FONT></B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>&#8201;</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">7.01</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>MEETING MINUTES.</B> As required by these Bylaws and Section 3.151 of the Code, the Corporation must keep a complete and accurate accounting and minutes of the proceedings of its shareholders and Board.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">7.02</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>SHAREHOLDER LIST.</B> Consistent with Section 3.151 of the Code and Section 21.173 of the Law, the Corporation must keep a list of its shareholders at its registered office, principal place of business, or other designated location. Such list must include the names and addresses of all shareholders and the number and class of shares held.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">7.03</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>LEGIBILITY OF RECORDS.</B> Any books, records, and minutes may be in any form, provided such form is capable of being converted into written form within a reasonable time.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>ARTICLE <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">8</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt"><B>Notices</B></FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>&#8201;</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">8.01</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>MAILING OF NOTICE.</B> Except as may otherwise be required by law, any notice to any shareholder or director may be delivered personally or by mail. If mailed, the notice will be deemed to have been delivered on the close of business of the third business day following the day when deposited in the United States mail with postage prepaid and addressed to the recipient&#8217;s last known address in the records of the Corporation.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 3.7pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 5.55pt"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">8.02</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>E-NOTICE PERMITTED.</B> Any communications required by the Law, these Bylaws, or other laws may be made by digital or electronic transmission to the recipient&#8217;s known electronic address or number as known to the Corporation at the time of notice.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">8.03</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>DUTY TO NOTIFY.</B> All shareholders, directors, officers, employees, and representatives of the Corporation are required to notify the Corporation of any changes to the individual&#8217;s contact information. Pursuant to the obligations under this Section of these Bylaws, the individual must notify the Corporation that electronic transmissions of notice are impracticable, impossible, frustrated, or otherwise improper and ineffective.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center">&#8201;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>ARTICLE <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.5pt">9</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>Special Corporate <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.2pt">Acts</FONT></B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>&#8201;</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">9.01</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>EXECUTION OF WRITTEN INSTRUMENTS.</B> All contracts, deeds, documents, and instruments that acquire, transfer, exchange, sell, or dispose of any assets of the Corporation must be executed by the President to bind the Corporation. This Section does not apply to any checks, money orders, notes, or other financial instruments for direct payment of corporate funds which are subject to Section 9.02 of these Bylaws.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">9.02</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>SIGNING OF CHECKS OR NOTES.</B> All authorizations to distribute, pay, or immediately draw upon the financial resources of the Corporation must be signed by the Treasurer or a designated representative of the Treasurer, including any expense reimbursement or compensation payments to directors, officers, employees, representatives, service providers, or contractors of the Corporation.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">9.03</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>SPECIAL SIGNING POWERS.</B> To duly bind the Corporation to an agreement or instrument in the event the President holds an interest which exists outside of the capacity of being President, then any agreement involving such interest must be signed by an officer pursuant to either Section 5.03 or 9.02 of these Bylaws or as may be otherwise directed by the Board.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">9.04</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>SHAREHOLDER APPROVAL.</B> Pursuant to Subchapter J of the Law, and until these Bylaws require otherwise, no shareholder approval is required to acquire, transfer, exchange, sell, or dispose of any assets of the Corporation in the ordinary course of business or after dissolving the Corporation. Notwithstanding any other provisions of these Bylaws, and consistent with Subchapter J of the Law, shareholder approval is required prior to any non-routine business operations, such as a merger, consolidation, share-exchange, conversion, or dissolution, and any loans that may be provided under Section 5.08 of these Bylaws.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">9.05</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>MERGERS &amp; CONVERSIONS.</B> Following the approval from the shareholders, in order for any consolidation, merger, conversion, or other organizational restructuring to be effective, it must follow the respective process(es) set out in Chapter 10 of the Code and Sections 21.452 and 21.453 of the Law.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0.05pt 5.7pt 0 0.5in; text-align: justify">&thinsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">9.06</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>DISSOLUTION.</B> Following the approval of the shareholders, in order for the Corporation to properly be dissolved, it must follow the process set out in Chapter 11 of the Code and Chapter 21, Subchapter K of the Law.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>&#8201;</B></P>

</DIV>
</CENTER>

<CENTER>
<DIV STYLE="width: 8.5in">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>ARTICLE <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">10</FONT></B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.1pt"><B>Amendments</B></FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"><B>&#8201;</B></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">10.01</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>BY SHAREHOLDERS.</B> These Bylaws may be altered, amended or repealed by the affirmative vote of a majority of the voting stock issued and outstanding at any regular or special shareholder meeting.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">10.02</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>BY DIRECTORS.</B> Subject to Section 21.057 of the Law, the Board has the power to make, alter, amend, and repeal the Corporation&#8217;s Bylaws. Any alteration, amendment, or repeal of the Bylaws may be changed or repealed by the holders of a majority of the stock entitled to vote at any shareholders meeting.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0.05pt; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">10.03</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>EMERGENCY BYLAWS.</B> Consistent with Section 3.252 of the Code, the Board may adopt emergency Bylaws, subject to a vote to repeal or modify by the shareholders, which operate during any emergency in the Corporation&#8217;s conduct of business resulting from an attack on the United States or a nuclear or atomic disaster.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.5in">&#8201;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="font-size: 8pt; width: 100%">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="width: 0%">&thinsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 0.5in; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">10.04</TD>
    <TD STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify"><B>COMPLIANCE WITH STATE LAW.</B> Any amendment to the Corporation&#8217;s Articles or these Bylaws shall be consistent with the Code and Law.</TD></TR>
  </TABLE>
